entities.summary: Antoine Jean Armand Gaston Cougny better known as Gaston Cougny was a French lawyer and historian. He and Adolphe Robert co-edited the Dictionnaire des parlementaires français (1889-1891). He also contributed to several political newspapers such as La Vérité, Le Radical and La France libre and took part in the creation of La Commune.
